sections.label: Everything your website needs, in one place
text: Everything your website needs, in one place
From the first sketch to the server it runs on, we handle the whole thing — so you can get back to running your business.
Design & build
A custom-designed site built around your business, not a stretched template. Fast, mobile-friendly and easy to find on Google.
Hosting & maintenance
Secure UK hosting, daily backups, software updates and uptime monitoring — all included, all handled by us.
Content updates
Need new prices, photos or a seasonal offer up? Just email us. Most changes go live within one working day.
Online bookings & shops
Take appointments, orders or payments online, integrated cleanly into your site rather than bolted on.
Local SEO
We set your site up to rank for the searches that matter locally, and share plain-English monthly reports.
Real support
A phone number and inbox with an actual person on the other end — not a ticket queue in another country.

sections.label: Common questions
text: Common questions
Do I own the website?
Yes. The site, its content and your domain name are yours. If you ever leave, we hand everything over in full — no lock-in.
What's included in the monthly plan?
Hosting, security updates, backups, uptime monitoring, technical support and a set number of content changes each month, depending on your plan.
How long does a build take?
Most sites go live within two to three weeks of starting, depending on how quickly we receive your content and feedback.
Can I cancel the monthly plan?
Yes, anytime, with 30 days' notice. There are no long-term contracts — we'd rather earn your business every month.
Do you help with photography or writing the words?
We can. Every plan includes guidance on what to write, and we offer optional photography and copywriting add-ons if you'd rather we handled it.
I already have a website — can you take it over?
Often, yes. We'll review your current site and either move it onto our hosting and plans, or rebuild it if that makes more sense.
